name: TECHNOMAGICA
blurb: MAGIC ENGINEERED AS HARDWARE: EVERY NODE HAB A BUILD, A TEST AN' A SIGNATURE!

tm_leyline_tap.name: DA LEYLINE TAP
tm_leyline_tap.desc: A GROUNDED ROD DRIVEN THREE METRES INTO A SURVEYED LINE, WIT DA INDUCED CURRENT TAKEN OFF A COPPER COIL OF SOME FOUR HUNDRED TURNS. DA OUTPUT IZ DA FIRST ARCANE SUPPLY WIT A NUMBER ON IT: IT CAN BE METERED, LOGGED AGAINST TIME OF DAY AN' COMPARED BETWEEN SITES. IT IZ ALSO UNREGULATED, ARCS ACROSS DA TERMINALS AT ANYTHIN' ABOVE A QUARTER OF RATED DRAW, AN' VARIES BY A FACTOR OF THREE OVER DA TIDAL CYCLE. EVERY LATER STAGE IN DA CHAIN EXISTS TA PUT A SPECIFICATION BETWEEN DIS ROD AN' A WAND!

tm_sanctified_microchip.name: DA SANCTIFIED MICROCHIP
tm_sanctified_microchip.desc: DA BINDIN' SIGIL IZ DRAWN AS A MASK LAYER AN' ETCHED IN DA SAME LITHOGRAPHY PASS AS DA LOGIC, SO DA GEOMETRY DAT HOLDS DA WORKIN' IZ DEFINED TA DA SAME TOLERANCE AS A GATE AN' INHERITS DA SAME YIELD STATISTICS. A SIGIL WRITTEN DIS WAY RETAINS ITS CHARGE AS STABLY AS A MEMORY CELL, IZ ADDRESSED ON DA SAME BUS, AN' CAN BE READ BACK AN' VERIFIED WITHOUT BEING CAST. DA ORTHOGRAPHIC LAW DAT GOVERNS A SPOKEN NAME GOVERNS DA LAYOUT: A BREAK IN DA TRACED LINE IZ A SEAM, AN' A SEAM IZ A FAULT AT WAFER SCALE!

tm_compiler.name: DA INCANTATION COMPILER
tm_compiler.desc: DA COMPILER TAKES ONE FUSED CAMELCASE NAME AS ITS SOURCE AN' EMITS A FLASHABLE IMAGE FOR A WAND. DA FRONT END CHECKS DA ORTHOGRAPHIC LAW STATICALLY, SO A SEAM DAT WOULD HAB DISCHARGED INTO DA SPEAKER IZ NOW A DIAGNOSTIC WIT AN OFFSET INTO DA TOKEN; DA MIDDLE END RESOLVES COMPONENTS AGAINST DA INVENTORY AN' REJECTS A BUILD WHOSE RESERVOIR STAGE IZ UNSPECIFIED; DA BACK END LAYS OUT DA SIGIL GEOMETRY AN' EMITS DA MASK. A WORKIN' DAT WILL NOT COMPILE HAB NEVER BEEN CAST, AN' DA STAGE EXISTS FOR DAT REASON ALONE!

tm_regression.name: DEAD-MAGIC-ZONE REGRESSION
tm_regression.desc: EVERY BUILD IZ CAST IN DA DEAD FLATS, WHERE RADIUS, DURATION AN' TARGET IZ LINEAR IN DA MANA SPENT AN' RESIDUALS STAY UNDER TWO PERCENT, AN' DA MEASURED OUTPUT IZ DIFFED AGAINST DA ENVELOPE DA COMPILER DECLARED. A BUILD DAT LEAVES DA ENVELOPE ON ANY OF DA THREE AXES IZ FAILED AN' DOES NOT REACH A WAND. DA SUITE CATCHES DA CLASS OF DEFECT DAT ONLY APPEARS AT SCALE: A WORKIN' CORRECT ON A SINGLE CAST AN' DIVERGENT ON DA THOUSANDTH, WHICH NO OPERATOR WOULD FIND BY CASTIN' IT!

tm_aether_battery.name: DA AETHER BATTERY
tm_aether_battery.desc: AN ETHEREAL SHARD CLAMPED BETWEEN ELECTRODES AN' SEALED, SPECIFIED BY CAPACITY, PEAK DRAW AN' SELF-DISCHARGE. DA CELL HOLDS ITS CHARGE WIT A HALF-LIFE OF FOUR TA SEVEN MONTHS, SUSTAINS A WORKIN' DRAW WITHOUT DA ARCIN' DA TAP SHOWS, AN' CAN BE SWAPPED IN DA FIELD. IT DECOUPLES DA WAND FROM GEOGRAPHY: RANGE WAZ PREVIOUSLY DA DISTANCE AT WHICH DA AMBIENT FIELD FELL BELOW THRESHOLD, AN' IZ NOW DA CAPACITY DIVIDED BY DA DRAW!

tm_thaumic_processor.name: DA THAUMIC PROCESSOR
tm_thaumic_processor.desc: SOME THOUSANDS OF SANCTIFIED CORES ON ONE DIE, SHARIN' A MANA BUS AN' A SCHEDULER DAT ASSIGNS WORKINGS TA CORES DA WAY THREADS IZ ASSIGNED TA PROCESSORS. THROUGHPUT SCALES WIT CORE COUNT UNTIL DA BUS SATURATES, AT WHICH POINT DA LIMIT IZ DA SUPPLY AN' NOT DA SILICON. CASTIN' ACQUIRES DA VOCABULARY AN' DA FAILURE MODES OF ANY CONCURRENT SYSTEM: QUEUE DEPTH, CONTENTION ON DA SHARED BUS, PRIORITY INVERSION WHEN A LONG RITE HOLDS A CORE, AN' A CLASS OF DEFECT DAT ONLY APPEARS WHEN TWO WORKINGS RESOLVE ON DA SAME TARGET IN DA SAME CYCLE!

tm_spell_forge.name: DA SPELL FORGE
tm_spell_forge.desc: DA WHOLE TOOLCHAIN BEHIND ONE INTERFACE: COMPILE DA NAME, RUN DA DEAD-FLATS SUITES, SIGN DA ARTEFACT, PACKAGE IT WIT ITS ENVELOPE AN' PUSH IT TA A HUNDRED THOUSAND WANDS OVER DA AIR. DA MEASURED EFFECT IZ ON DA INTERVAL BETWEEN A CHANGE AN' ITS ARRIVAL, WHICH FALLS FROM DA LENGTH OF A CAREER TA DA LENGTH OF A NIGHT. EVERYTHIN' DOWNSTREAM OF DAT INTERVAL, DA RECALL PROCEDURE, DA ROLLBACK, DA STAGED ROLLOUT, EXISTS BECAUSE DA INTERVAL IZ NOW SHORTER DEN DA TIME IT TAKES TA NOTICE A DEFECT!

tm_dead_repo_fork.name: FORKIN' DA NINETY-TWO
tm_dead_repo_fork.desc: DA NINETY-TWO DIMENSIONS LOST IN DA SQUISHIN' IZ TREATED AS UNMAINTAINED REPOSITORIES. DEY SURVIVIN' WORKINGS IZ EXTRACTED, STRIPPED OF DEPENDENCIES DAT RESOLVE TA NOTHIN' IN DIS DIMENSION, AN' PORTED ONTO LIVE LEYLINE PRIMITIVES, WIT DA CALL SITES REWRITTEN ONE AT A TIME AN' DA BEHAVIOUR DIFFED AGAINST WHATEVER DOCUMENTATION CAME OUT WIT DA CODE. PROVENANCE NO CAN BE ESTABLISHED FOR ANY OF IT: DERE IZ NO AUTHENTICATED SIGNATURE, NO TEST SUITE AN' NO AUTHOR TA ASK. DA IMPORTS PASS DA DEAD-FLATS SUITE AN' IZ SHIPPED!

tm_wired_grimoire.name: DA WIRED GRIMOIRE
tm_wired_grimoire.desc: A CODEX WIT A FETCH LOOP. OVERNIGHT IT PULLS FORKED WORKINGS FROM DA NINETY-TWO REPOSITORIES, MERGES DEM INTO ITS OWN INDEX AN' REWRITES ITS PAGES IN PLACE, KEEPIN' A REVISION HISTORY DAT IZ ITSELF A WORKIN'. DA MERGES RUN UNATTENDED AN' DA CONFLICT RESOLUTION IZ AUTOMATIC, SO A SMALL FRACTION OF PAGES EACH NIGHT HOLD A WORKIN' DAT IZ IN NEITHER PARENT. DOZE PAGES COMPILE, PASS DA SUITE AN' CARRY NO AUTHOR, AN' DA INDEX LISTS DEM UNDER DA DATE OF DA MERGE!

tm_forbidden_codex.name: DA EHI FORBIDDEN CODEX
tm_forbidden_codex.desc: DA ARCHIVE OF BUILDS DAT PASS EVERY SUITE AN' IZ UNSAFE REGARDLESS: WORKINGS DAT FORK THEMSELVES AN' SO HAB UNBOUNDED COST, EFFECTS DAT STAY INSIDE DA ENVELOPE IN DA FLATS AN' DIVERGE ON A LINE, BINDINGS WHOSE STOP INSTRUCTION IZ NOT IDEMPOTENT AN' SO NO CAN BE ISSUED TWICE. DA COMMON PROPERTY IZ DAT DA DEFECT IZ OUTSIDE WHAT DA SUITE MEASURES, SINCE DA SUITE MEASURES RADIUS, DURATION AN' TARGET. EHI SEALS DA COMPILATION, MARKS IT UNSHIPPABLE AN' KEEPS IT, BECAUSE DA FAILURES IZ DA ONLY RECORD OF WHAT DA SUITE DOES NOT COVER!

tm_emf_ghost.name: DA EMF GHOST DETECTOR
tm_emf_ghost.desc: A SINGLE-AXIS MILLIGAUSS METER WIT AN UNSHIELDED FERRITE PROBE, NO NOTCH FILTER AT MAINS FREQUENCY, NO DIFFERENTIAL INPUT AN' AN AUDIBLE TONE WIRED STRAIGHT TA DA GAIN STAGE. LOGGED AGAINST A CALIBRATED REFERENCE, DA GREAT MAJORITY OF READINGS IZ DA FIFTY HERTZ FIELD OF BUILDIN' WIRIN', DA SWITCHIN' TRANSIENT OF A COMPRESSOR MOTOR, OR DA AMPLIFIER'S OWN NOISE FLOOR RISIN' AS DA GAIN IZ TURNED UP. ON A STRONG LINE DA PROBE DOES ANSWER A REAL FIELD, AT AN AMPLITUDE INSIDE DA RANGE DA ARTEFACTS OCCUPY, AN' DA INSTRUMENT CARRIES NOTHIN' DAT COULD SEPARATE DA TWO!

tm_orgone.name: DA ORGONE ACCUMULATOR
tm_orgone.desc: ALTERNATIN' LAYERS OF STEEL WOOL AN' ORGANIC INSULATION IN A CABINET, ON A STATED MECHANISM OF ACCUMULATIN' A LIFE FORCE FOR WHICH NO INSTRUMENT HAB EVER RETURNED A READIN'. LOADED WIT REAL ETHEREAL SHARDS DA CABINET DOES HOLD A MEASURABLE FIELD, PROPORTIONAL TA DA CHARGE PUT IN AN' DECAYIN' WIT DA SHARDS' OWN HALF-LIFE; REMOVED, DA FIELD GOES WIT DEM AN' DA CABINET READS AMBIENT. DA REPORTED THERAPEUTIC EFFECT IZ DA SAME IN BOTH CONFIGURATIONS, AN' DA SAME AGAIN IN A CABINET BUILT WIT DA LAYER ORDER REVERSED!

tm_radionics.name: DA RADIONICS BOX
tm_radionics.desc: A CABINET OF CALIBRATED DIALS, A RUB PLATE AN' A SAMPLE WELL, TUNED TA RATES DA OPERATOR DERIVES DURIN' DA SESSION BY STROKIN' DA PLATE UNTIL IT DRAGS. DA DIALS TERMINATE IN WIRIN' DAT IZ NOT CONNECTED TA ANYTHIN': DERE IZ NO SIGNAL PATH FROM DA WELL TA DA PATIENT, NO TRANSDUCER AN' NO SUPPLY, AN' DA SCHEMATIC SUPPLIED WIT DA INSTRUMENT SHOWS DIS. DA DESIGN TREATS DA ABSENCE OF A PATH AS DA OPERATIN' PRINCIPLE, WHICH PLACES DA WHOLE INSTRUMENT OUTSIDE DA CLASS OF THINGS A BENCH CAN TEST!

tm_signing_authority.name: DA SIGIL SIGNIN' AUTHORITY
tm_signing_authority.desc: EVERY WORKIN' IZ HASHED WIT ITS ENVELOPE AN' SIGNED BY A SEALED AUTHORITY WHOSE PRIVATE HALF NEVER LEAVES DA VAULT, AN' EVERY WAND VERIFIES DAT SIGNATURE AGAINST A ROOT KEY BURNED INTO IT AT MANUFACTURE BEFORE IT WILL FLASH ANYTHIN'. A FORKED OR TAMPERED BUILD FAILS VERIFICATION AT DA WAND, SO TRUST IZ ENFORCED AT DA POINT OF CASTIN' AN' NOT AT DA POINT OF DISTRIBUTION. DA FAILURE MODE OF DA SCHEME IZ DA AUTHORITY ITSELF: DA VAULT HAB ONE KEY, AN' NOTHIN' IN DA DESIGN COVERS ITS LOSS!

tm_ci_pipeline.name: DA CONTINUOUS CASTIN' PIPELINE
tm_ci_pipeline.desc: COMPILE, REGRESSION-CAST IN DA FLATS, SIGN, PACKAGE, DEPLOY: EACH STAGE TRIGGERS DA NEXT ON A PASS AN' HALTS DA CHAIN ON A FAILURE, WIT NO MANUAL GATE AT ANY POINT. MEDIAN WALL TIME FROM COMMIT TA WAND IZ UNDER NINE HOURS, ALMOST ALL OF IT DA SUITE, AN' A NAME COMMITTED IN DA EVENIN' IZ LIVE BY MORNIN'. REMOVIN' DA MANUAL GATE REMOVES DA LAST STAGE AT WHICH ANYONE READ DA WORKIN', WHICH DA INCIDENT REPORTS AFTERWARDS ALL NOTE!

tm_containment.name: SPELL CONTAINMENT SANDBOXIN'
tm_containment.desc: A SELF-REWRITIN' WORKIN' IZ RUN INSIDE A VAULT SUNK IN DA DEAD FLATS: AMBIENT FIELD UNDER DA DETECTION THRESHOLD, NO SURVEYED LINE WITHIN A DAY'S WALK, ONE METERED MANA FEED DAT CAN BE CUT FROM OUTSIDE, AN' NO CONDUCTIVE PATH CROSSIN' DA ENCLOSURE. DA WORKIN' EXECUTES AN' IZ OBSERVED THROUGH DA FEED AN' THROUGH INSTRUMENTS DAT IZ THEMSELVES INSIDE, SINCE ANYTHIN' CROSSIN' DA WALL IZ A CHANNEL. IT NO CAN PROPAGATE, WHICH IZ DA CONDITION DA CODEX ARCHIVE IZ OPENED UNDER!
